source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the mechanism of DNA replication (PDF 126-129).

blocks.text: DNA replication ka bunyadi tareeqa tamam jandaron mein milta julta hai. Neeche diye gaye qadam prokaryotes ki replication ke hain, lekin eukaryotes bhi taqreeban yahi tareeqa apnate hain.
1- DNA double helix ko kholna

DNA ki replication DNA molecule par aik ya zyada jaghon se shuru hoti hai jahan nucleotides ka aik khaas sequence hota hai; ise replication origin site kehte hain. Prokaryotes mein sirf aik replication origin site hoti hai, jab ke eukaryotes mein DNA ki lambai par bohat si origin sites hoti hain.

items: Initiator protein replication origin site se jur kar amal shuru karta hai.

Origin site par “kholne wale” (unwinding) enzymes, jinhein helicases kehte hain, dono strands ke nucleotide pairs (base pairs) ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds tor dete hain. Strands thore se alag ho kar do Y shakal ke structures banate hain jinhein replication forks kehte hain (dono mil kar replication bubble kehlate hain).
DNA helix ke khulne se replication fork ke aage supercoils (zyada bal) parh jate hain.
Enzyme gyrase (ya topoisomerase) replication fork ke aage jur jata hai aur dobara supercoiling nahin hone deta.
Single-strand binding proteins akele strands se jur kar unhein dobara jurne aur lipatne se rokte hain.
Dono replication forks aik doosre se door hatte hain taa ke dono forks par replication ho sake. Dono akele strands agle qadmon ke liye template (saancha) bante hain.

blocks.text: 2- Primer banana

Khule hue strands par naya DNA tab tak nahin ban sakta jab tak template par pehle se kuch nucleotides na lage hon. Is ke liye enzyme primase origin site par har template strand ke saamne kuch RNA nucleotides laga deta hai. 5-10 RNA nucleotides ke is chhote tukre ko primer kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Replication bubble: double helix beech se khulta hai aur dono siron par replication fork hai. Har fork par aage duplex par gyrase aur fork par helicase; peele single-strand binding proteins alag strands ko thaame rakhte hain; jamni primase har fork ke qareeb template strand par chhota primer rakhta hai.

blocks.text: 3- Complementary strands jorna (extension)
Asal banane wala: DNA polymerase III

Enzyme DNA polymerase dono template strands ke saath naye nucleotides jorta hai. Prokaryotes mein DNA polymerase I, polymerase II aur polymerase III hote hain, lekin asal (main) enzyme DNA polymerase III hai. Yeh cell mein azaad tairte nucleotides ko pakar kar khule template strand ke mutabiq jorta hai (A ke saath T, aur C ke saath G).

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: DNA polymerase I replication ke aakhir mein primers ko hata kar polymerase III ki madad karta hai. Polymerase II cell ki zindagi bhar DNA ke nuqsan (damage) ki marammat (repair) mein kaam aata hai.
Khaam maal (raw materials)

Naye strands banane ke liye jo units istemal hoti hain woh deoxyribonucleoside triphosphates (dATP, dCTP, dGTP, dTTP) hain. In molecules mein teen phosphate groups hote hain. Jab DNA polymerase III aik nucleotide strand se jorta hai to us ke do phosphate tor deta hai. Is se energy nikalti hai jo jorne ke kaam mein lagti hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: DNA ke bajaye RNA primer kyun? Khule template par zanjeer shuru karte waqt bohat ghaltiyan hoti hain. RNA is shuru ke hisse ko “aarzi” (temporary) ka nishan de deta hai, is liye baad mein is ghalti wale hisse ko kaat kar nikalna aasaan hota hai.
Aik taraf ka traffic (5′ se 3′ ki simt)

DNA polymerase III naya nucleotide sirf pehle se maujood nucleotide ke 3′ sire par hi jor sakta hai. Pehle yeh primer ke 3′ sire par nucleotide jorta hai, phir 5′ se 3′ ki simt (direction) mein jorta chala jata hai. Kyun ke asal DNA ke dono strands mukhalif simton mein chalte hain, is liye enzyme ko dono ke saath alag tareeqe se kaam karna parta hai.
Leading strand banana

Enzyme ki aik unit us template strand se jurti hai jo khulte hue "fork" ki taraf chalta hai. Kyun ke enzyme usi simt mein chal raha hai jidhar DNA khul raha hai, is liye woh 5′ se 3′ ki aik musalsal (continuous) zanjeer mein nucleotides jor sakta hai. Aaram se musalsal barhne wale is daughter strand ko leading strand kehte hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Leading strand sirf aik primer se barh sakta hai, jab ke lagging strand ko har Okazaki fragment ke liye naya primer chahiye (Okazaki fragments ka naam inhein daryaft karne wale Japani scientist ke naam par hai).
Lagging strand banana

Enzyme ki doosri unit doosre template strand par kaam karti hai. Lekin 5′ se 3′ ki simt qaim rakhne ke liye use replication fork se door chalna parta hai. Jaise jaise DNA aage khulta hai, enzyme ko peeche "chhalang" laga kar naye primer par naya tukra shuru karna parta hai. Is liye yeh daughter strand fork se door tukron mein (discontinuous) barhta hai aur DNA ke chhote alag alag tukre banata hai jinhein Okazaki fragments kehte hain. Kyun ke yeh strand aik lambe tukre ke bajaye "ruk ruk kar" banta hai, is liye ise lagging strand kehte hain.
4- Replication ka khatma (termination)

Replication nucleotides ke aik khaas sequence par khatam hoti hai jise termination site kehte hain. Origin site aur termination site ke darmiyan DNA ka hissa replication unit ya replicon kehlata hai. Termination ke dauran DNA polymerase I RNA primer ko hata kar khaali jagah DNA nucleotides se bhar deta hai; Okazaki fragments ke darmiyan ki khaali jaghein bhi bharta hai. Enzyme DNA ligase lagging strand ke Okazaki fragments ko aapas mein jorta hai.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text: Replication mein asal DNA ka aik strand mehfooz (conserve) rehta hai aur daughter strand bilkul naya banta hai. Yaani DNA ki har nayi nasl mein asal DNA molecule ka aadha hissa mehfooz rehta hai.

blocks.alt: Aik replication fork. Aage parental double helix par gyrase aur helicase strands kholta hai. Oopri bazu par DNA polymerase III leading strand ko fork ki taraf musalsal banata hai. Neeche lagging strand fork se door Okazaki fragments ki soorat banta hai; har tukra primase ke banaye RNA primer se shuru hota hai, DNA polymerase III use barhata, DNA ligase jorta aur single-strand binding proteins template khula rakhte hain. Teer replication ki simt dikhate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono naye strands sirf 5′ se 3′ ki taraf bante hain. Leading strand fork ki taraf musalsal banta hai, is liye aik primer kaafi hai. Lagging strand fork se door chhote tukron (Okazaki fragments) mein banta hai: har tukre ko naya primer chahiye, aur aakhir mein DNA ligase tukron ko jor deta hai.
Prokaryotes aur eukaryotes mein DNA replication ka farq
Jagah (location): prokaryotes mein replication cytoplasm mein hoti hai (kyun ke un mein nucleus nahin). Eukaryotes mein DNA replication nucleus mein hoti hai.
Polymerases: prokaryotes mein DNA polymerase I, II aur III replication mein kaam karte hain. Eukaryotes mein kam az kam 14 polymerases hain (jaise alpha, delta aur epsilon).

Initiation aur termination sites: prokaryotes ke DNA mein aik hi origin site aur aik hi termination site hoti hai. Eukaryotes mein har chromosome par kai origin aur termination sites hoti hain aur replication har origin site par aik saath (simultaneously) shuru hoti hai. Is liye har chromosome mein kai replicons hote hain.
Okazaki fragments: prokaryotes mein Okazaki fragments lambe hote hain (1000 se 2000 nucleotides). Eukaryotes mein chhote hote hain (100 se 200 nucleotides).

Raftaar (speed): prokaryotes apna chhota DNA bohat jaldi copy kar lete hain. Eukaryotes ke paas linear (seedha) DNA bohat zyada miqdar mein hota hai. Is kami ko poora karne ke liye eukaryotes aik hi chromosome par hazaron mukhtalif origin sites se aik saath replication shuru karte hain.

blocks.title: For Information
blocks.text:
Biotechnologists DNA replication ko nayi technologies mein istemal karte hain, maslan:
• Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) mein scientists replication kar ke kisi khaas DNA ki arbon copies banate hain.
• Recombinant DNA technology mein scientists mukhtalif zaraye se DNA kaatte hain, phir replication se DNA molecules ki tadaad barhate (amplify karte) hain.
• Genome sequencing mein replication se genome ki bohat si copies banti hain, phir un ka sequence parha jata hai.
• Tashkhees (diagnostic studies) mein mareez ke DNA ke khaas hisse copy kar ke un mein tabdeeliyan ya mutations dhoondi jati hain taa ke genetic bimari ka pata chale.
DNA ki stability aur variability

Yeh replicate hone wale DNA ki do ahem khoobiyan hain. “Stability” (pakka pan) ka matlab hai DNA ka bilkul durust copy hona. DNA polymerase III (aur eukaryotic polymerases) mein "proofreading" (ghalti pakar kar theek karne) ki salahiyat hoti hai jis se nucleotides ka sequence wahi rehta hai. Yeh yaksaniyat bohat zaroori hai kyun ke is se jandar ki khaas khasiyatein (traits) qaim rehti hain aur cells theek kaam karte hain.

Stability qaida hai aur “variability” (tabdeeli) istisna (exception). Kabhi kabhi DNA sequence mein mustaqil tabdeeli aa jati hai jise mutation kehte hain. Mutations replication ki ghaltiyon se bhi hoti hain aur mahol ke asraat (environmental factors) se bhi. Variability nayi khasiyaton ka bunyadi zariya hai; is se populations badalte mahol mein dhal sakti hain, aur yahi evolution ka khaam maal hai.

blocks.prompt: Lagging strand tukron (Okazaki fragments) mein kyun banta hai?
blocks.explanation: DNA polymerase III sirf 3′ sire par nucleotide jor sakta hai, yaani strand sirf 5′ se 3′ barhta hai. Lagging template par yeh simt fork se door hai, is liye jaise jaise fork khulta hai, enzyme ko naye primer se dobara shuru karna parta hai aur chhote tukre bante hain.

items: Helicase strands kholta; gyrase supercoiling rokta; single-strand binding proteins strands alag rakhte; primase RNA primer lagata.
DNA polymerase III 5′ se 3′ jorta: leading strand musalsal, lagging strand Okazaki fragments mein.
